name: PalmsTrack – WordPress Costs & Subscriptions Tracker
author: PalmsTrack

sections.description:
Visualize your WordPress site costs, keep track of plugin and SaaS subscription renewals, and optimize your site’s costs to improve its profitability. Learn more about palmstrack.com.

Links

  • Documentation
  • Blog
  • Contact

Why PalmsTrack?

WordPress plugin expenses can accumulate quickly. PalmsTrack helps you:
– Visualize detailed expense breakdowns.
– Know when your subscriptions and free trials are due.
– Optimize costs to improve your site’s profitability.
– Make better financial decisions with clear, actionable insights.

Features

– Plugin Tracking: Automatically sync and monitor your installed plugins.
– 3rd Party Subscriptions: Include hosting, domain, and other services alongside plugins.
– Renewal Alerts: Receive timely notifications for upcoming subscription renewals.
– CSV Export: Backup and analyze your subscription data with CSV exports.
– Free Trials Tracking: Keep tabs on free trial periods and their expiration dates.
– Insights Dashboard: View projected monthly and annual costs along with a cost breakdown by category.

More Features

– Scheduled Email Digests: Get regular email summaries of upcoming renewals.
– License Key Manager: Store and manage your plugin license keys.
– Cost Analysis: Generate detailed reports to optimize your spending.
– Insights API: Compare your expenses with similar WordPress sites for smarter budgeting.
– Calendars Integration: Sync with Google Calendar to schedule reminders for renewals and trial expirations.
– Data Privacy: All data stays on your site—no external servers or third‑party access without your consent.

1.6

  • Onboarding Enhancements:

    • A new onboarding slideshow has been integrated into the main subscriptions dashboard. New users will now see an interactive step-by-step guide upon their first visit.

  • Elevated UI Components:

    • Modified the styling of dashboard elements to improve the user experience
    • Added feedback notifications for interactions with the dashboard

  • Bug Fixes & UI Stability:

    • Fixed various minor bugs and performance issues to enhance the overall user experience.

  • FullCalendar Integration:

    • Integrated FullCalendar to enhance the UI with a calendar view for subscription and trial renewals.

1.5

  • Introduced free trials tracking and an enhanced insights dashboard for projected monthly and annual cost breakdowns.
  • Various UI improvements and performance enhancements.

1.4

  • Added stable tag 1.4 and introduced a settings page with UI improvements.
  • Expanded functionality for managing plugin subscriptions and recurring expenses.

1.3

  • Added support for 3rd party subscriptions, including hosting and domain services.

1.2

  • Initial stable release featuring plugin subscription tracking, renewal alerts, and CSV export.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “PalmsTrack Subscription Tracker”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the latest release as a .zip file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new subscription?

Installed plugins are automatically added and can be refreshed by clicking the Sync Plugins button in the My Subscriptions dashboard.

How do I export my data?

Go to My Subscriptions and click Export.
